description: Enhanced boundary coverage for Feature 1 (broadcast-and-return). Covers: zero registered sinks (call returns its payload but produces no per-sink line), three sinks fanning a single call out in registration order, duplicate sink kinds both receiving the call, empty-string payloads at message and error levels, a non-alphabetical registration order to confirm output follows registration order (not label order), and a single request issuing all four severity levels in sequence across three sinks.
